parsed.why: State anti-discrimination covers public accommodations and hate crimes, with no adult facilities ban; national border/custody exposure remains. School restrictions are youth-focused.
No statewide gender-identity protections or hate-crime cover, but no facilities ban or sex-definition law; local patchwork and supportive vetoes leave visitor-facing exposure mostly national.
Strongest package: public-accommodations and hate-crime protections, care-access shield, no facilities ban, low trans-homicide rate; national entry/custody layer still applies.
Most-protective tier with care shield and insurance, but documented birth-sex prison transfer and unresolved anti-trans ballot initiatives temper the local protection.
Explicit sex-definition/facilities ban reaches restrooms, shelters, dorms and prisons; religious-refusal law allows service denial; no statewide protections, worst-tier assessment.
